extras: Paid features (books, image export, WeChat formatting) require a lifetime membership or trial; core review features are free. All processing is done locally.
intentEvidence: Rediscover old journal entries, revisit this day in past years, and save reflections to today's note.
problem: Users need a way to easily revisit past notes, organize them into readable formats, and export them for sharing on social media or archiving.
summary: A note management tool that allows users to review past entries, read notes as books, and format content for image or WeChat article export.
